description: RQ1 simulator swap: same agent (Qwen3-4B, temp 0), same tasks and seed, different user-simulator LLMs. Uses the 29 judge-free tasks of the 40-task retail test split (PREREGISTRATION section 4; tasks with NL assertions are excluded); train is kept for pilots and Hinglish prompt development.

simulators.name: gptoss120b
simulators.notes: Groq free plan: 30 RPM, 1K RPD, 8K TPM, 200K TPD. Measured 6-9K tokens/simulation.

simulators.name: qwen3.8-27b
simulators.notes: Groq free plan (verify limits in the Groq console). Measured 8,654 mean user tokens/simulation over 18 test-split sims (rq1 chunk 1, 2026-10-11); 1-task smoke had 5,697. Groq ITPM limit for this model is 7,000.
